cases.question: Tell me about Pdfroo
cases.judge_reason: All claims match the expected facts and known public details about Pdfroo.
cases.answer:
**Pdfroo** is Ayush's fully client-side PDF editor — open a PDF in your browser, annotate, sign, reorder/merge pages, find & replace, compress, and download a real flattened PDF. **Nothing uploads**; all parsing, rendering, and writing happen locally via **pdf.js + pdf-lib**, and it works offline once loaded.

**Highlights**
- Runs on phones, tablets, desktops (mouse, pen, touch)
- No build step, no backend, no install — just open `index.html` or hit the live demo
- Thumbnail sidebar (desktop), slide-in drawer (tablet), bottom sheet (mobile) with drag-to-reorder (SortableJS)
- Rotate, duplicate, delete, insert blank pages, merge multiple PDFs
- Light/dark theme, local fonts, SVG kangaroo mascot
- Privacy-first "pouch promise" — your PDF never leaves your device

**Links**
- Live demo: https://ayush4u.github.io/pdfroo/
- Repo: https://github.com/ayush4u/pdfroo (MIT License)
- Stack: JavaScript, CSS, HTML (pdf.js, pdf-lib, SortableJS)

He built it as a personal open-source tool — fast, private, and genuinely useful.
